title: Each cell type holds its own fixed level; the train left
set_out: Derive each cell type's own level (A8) first; bring every derived input into the chain and confirm it end to end with one command; consolidate the plans into the register.
open_at_turnover: The train's remaining libraries and the location test riding it; the growth-rate comparison order check; the book corrections through the canon; the virial thread on IAM's web; the six-paper and Koide audit.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: Each cell type's own level, 31 atlas libraries by one command (A8)
entries.what: Spent atlas libraries of T cells, neurons, heart and skeletal muscle, liver, smooth muscle, fat and oligodendrocytes, one command each on GitHub.
entries.outcome: Each healthy type sits at its own fixed level; no rise with donor age (pooled slope -0.0055 per decade, 95 % range -0.0135 to +0.0034).

entries.title: Traffic and packing against each type's level (A8)
entries.what: Open-chromatin extent (a public accessibility atlas) and packed-state share (Roadmap chromatin states), names tables written before reading.

entries.title: Candidate fingerprints through the one command (A8, synthetic)
entries.what: Planted molecules for a slower restore crew, a damaged share of cells, losses in stretches and marks caught mid-erase, each raising the true loss by 25 %.
entries.outcome: The chain tells all four apart; stretch losses and mid-erase marks barely move the reading.

entries.title: The line tested tile by tile inside one sample (PHY-013)
entries.what: The tile-by-tile line added to every IAM-A count, checked first on planted molecules.
entries.outcome: Synthetic met; now carried in every reading.

entries.title: End-to-end checks and the train (JOINT)
entries.what: One command on a naive CD4 T and an adipocyte library, then all 156 spent atlas libraries in waves.
entries.outcome: Both checks met exactly (A 0.8329 and 1.0241); 51 libraries sent and 42 read cleanly by midnight.

sections.heading: What we learned that we did not know yesterday

entries.title: A cell type's level is fixed by what it is
entries.what: Energy, division, working regions, open-chromatin extent and packed-state share do not explain the spread at this depth; the spread is about a third of one thermal kick in holding energy.

entries.title: "The transaction happens locally"
entries.what: The author's ATM picture: writing happens on the local surface; the horizon is the ledger, the balance on the screen.

sections.heading: Our own mistakes and what caught them

entries.title: A helper's claims about the chains published unread
entries.what: An archive note repeated a helper's unverified claims about the cosmology chains. The author and the reviewer caught it; the note was replaced within the hour by the record's own summary of the 17 converged chains.
